scope_summary: Scope idempotency records by owner while preserving a separate unique namespace for system-owned records.
Resolve concurrent first-use idempotency key conflicts through a savepoint and row lock.
Require account and strategy ownership when creating, resolving, listing, exporting, projecting, or aggregating positions.
Fail closed when truth lifecycle events, reversal references, ledger rows, opening or closing references cross an owner or position boundary.
Validate transaction, event, position, account, and ledger ownership graphs before ledger writes and journal-balance aggregation.
Return 404 without side effects for foreign public IDs, internal IDs, nested IDs, and corrupted mixed-owner graphs.
Keep legacy Import routes deny-only until the JRN-011 replacement exists.
Freeze the owner contract and reusable two-user probe harness for future Import and source reconciliation resources without claiming nonexistent models are tested.
Require a separate audited interface for any future administrator cross-owner operation; the current administrator role has no implicit journal CRUD bypass.

residual_risks: GitHub Actions has not run for this checkpoint, so remote CI and required-check evidence remain unproven for JRN-002, JRN-003, and JRN-004.

After different owners create the same scope/key pair, downgrade to the former global uniqueness constraint can fail. JRN-019 must define a preflight and forward-fix or data-disposition policy instead of assuming a lossless rollback.

Owner consistency is enforced by application queries and tests rather than composite database foreign keys, so direct out-of-band database writes can still create corrupt graphs that application reads must reject.

Journal-balance validation currently performs nested owner checks per ledger row. This is correct for the Beta boundary but may become an N+1 performance bottleneck; JRN-006 should replace it with constrained relational queries or database invariants before ledger volume grows.

ImportSession, source binding, execution, observation, application, and reconciliation resources do not exist yet and remain required to instantiate the frozen owner probe harness in JRN-011 through JRN-015.
